findings.evidence: `TauCeti/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialComplex/Maps.lean:37` defines `SimplicialMap K L` for different vertex types; lines 95 and 160 provide composition and inclusion. The PR instead defines and proves functoriality only for order witnesses at Realization.lean:182–213.
findings.fix: Define realization functoriality first for `f : SimplicialMap K.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex L.toPreAbstractSimplicialComplex`, using the induced barycentric `Finsupp` map, and derive the inclusion map and its continuity/composition lemmas from `SimplicialMap.inclusion`.
findings.issue: `realizationMap` handles only `K ≤ L` on one vertex type, a special case of the affine map induced by an arbitrary simplicial map between complexes with different vertex types.

summary: The realization map API is restricted to inclusions, although the existing simplicial-map abstraction supports the natural general construction.
